events.title: Theorycraft is coming to Next Fest!
events.summary: Theorycraft v0.1.8 - Ready for Steam Next Fest! Version 0.1.8 is our Steam Next Fest build, and the demo is available to play right now! Jump in, build your raid, and take on the bosses. We'd love to hear what you think. Coming From the v0.1.5 Alpha? If you've been alpha testing on v0.1.5-alpha, here's what you can expect: raiders who learn each boss, a way to plan fights before you pull, more control over your guild, full controller support, and a fresh new look. events.title: Alpha build v0.1.7 is coming to NextFest!
events.summary: Alpha 0.1.7 patch notes: everything new since 0.1.4 The 0.1.7 alpha build is out! This post covers everything that changed in 0.1.5, 0.1.6 and 0.1.7, so if you last played 0.1.4, this is your full catch-up. Most of this round is about your guild: a founding story, paid recruiting, a smarter guild bank, specialization bonuses and boss knowledge that grows with every attempt. events.title: Announcing Theorycraft!
events.summary: Hello,I go by Jex, and for 10 years I've been working to make this game a reality- my homage and love letter to my favorite gaming experience of all time. It started as an excel spreadsheet and has now grown into a bespoke c++ game engine. More info to come soon- I am planning to participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest.-Jex
